entities.name: George E. Stratemeyer

entities.summary: Lieutenant General George Edward Stratemeyer was a senior commander in the United States Air Force. He held senior command appointments in the China Burma India Theater of World War II and was Far East Air Forces commander during the first year of the Korean War.
